title: Barcelona easy aerobic, no strides
terrain: Barcelona seafront, flat; skip the Montjuic climb
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 50min flat seafront at 138-148bpm, cadence 172+. No Montjuic, no strides. Morning before the 16:45 flight from BCN.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water.
GARMIN: ~50-65.
STOP RULE: HRV under 45 or under 6h sleep after the summit dinner, 35min at 135-145bpm. HR drifting over 148 on flat ground, walk 1min and reset.
WHY: Tuesday ran 115 vs 90 with 39min in Z4-Z5 on HRV 44. Wed absorbs it so Saturday's 2h30 / 900m starts on fresh legs.
